title: Ya-Sin 36:49-52 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y10 lesson 29 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Ya-Sin 36:49-52 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 29. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ (٤٩) فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةًۭ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ (٥٠) وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ (٥١) قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ (٥٢)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.
And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.
And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.
They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Idgham with ghunnah: tanween into و
Saktah (small س): pause without breath, then continue

keywords.def: a short pause without taking a breath

questions.q: Chunk and link Ya-Sin 36:49-52 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 36:49-52 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 36:49-52 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Explain 36:50: why can they not even make a will?
questions.a: The blast is sudden; there is no time to give instructions or return to family.

questions.q: Who speaks in the second half of 36:52, after the saktah?
questions.a: Most scholars of tafsir say it is the answer given to them (from the angels or the believers): 'This is what the Most Merciful promised'; the saktah separates the two speakers.

questions.q: How does 36:49 describe the end of the world?
options: A single blast that seizes people while they dispute
questions.a: A) A single blast that seizes people while they dispute. 36:49.

questions.q: Ya-Sin 36:51: «وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: People rising from their graves will say, 'Who has raised us from our sleeping place?' (36:52). What does calling the grave a 'sleeping place' suggest?
questions.a: That the time in the grave will feel short, like a sleep, compared with the Day of Resurrection.
